ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description first: The image shows a transition-state drawing with a tetrachloroaluminate unit at the upper left: Al in the center connected to four Cl atoms, with a negative charge shown nearby. The organic part shows a six-membered carbon ring with drawn C-C edges and double-bond markings, a positive charge in the ring, and a substituent from the ring to a carbonyl group. The carbonyl carbon is double-bonded to O and single-bonded to R. An H label and curved arrows are also present, but the question says to exclude hydrogen-involving bonds and disregard arrows. Reasoning following the assigned method: Count the tetrachloroaluminate portion as four Al-Cl bonds. For the organic heavy-atom framework, count six C-C bonds around the six-membered ring, one bond from the ring to the carbonyl carbon, one carbonyl C=O bond, and one carbonyl carbon-to-R bond. Excluding any C-H or H-related bond, the total is 4 + 6 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 13.
